📖 How to use

  1. Type your full name.
  2. Each letter is valued A=1 … I=9, repeating.
  3. The total reduces to 1–9 or a master number 11/22/33.
  4. Read what your life-path number says — for fun.

❓ Frequently asked questions

Is numerology real?

No. Numerology is entertainment, not science — the number has no power over your life or decisions.

How are letters valued?

A=1, B=2 … I=9, then J=1, K=2 and so on — the values 1–9 repeat through the alphabet. Non-letters are ignored.

Why do 11, 22 and 33 stay as they are?

11, 22 and 33 are “master numbers” and are not reduced further, following traditional numerology.
